Concentration Equations:

db/dt=d(a->b)/dt-d(b->c)/dt
dc/dt=d(b->c)/dt
dd/dt=-d(d->e)/dt
de/dt=d(d->e)/dt-d(e->f)/dt
df/dt=d(e->f)/dt

Mass=InitialMass-TotalMassChange*[Contribution(a->b)*Integral[d(a->b)/dt]dt + Contribution(b->c)*Integral[d(b->c)/dt]dt + Contribution(d->e)*Integral[d(d->e)/dt]dt + Contribution(e->f)*Integral[d(e->f)/dt]dt]
